units.source_text: "忍着点儿！忍着点儿！马上给你治！马上！"

en.t: "Bear it a little longer! Bear it a little longer! I will treat you right away! Right away!"
she said in a raised voice.

units.source_text: 我头一回听见她这种分若无人的高亢的声音。

en.t: It was the first time I had heard that kind of high-pitched, brazen voice from her.

units.source_text: 地伸长脖子，仰起头来环视了四周，

en.t: She stretched out her neck, lifted her head, and looked all around,

units.source_text: 旋即跪在事村的石头上，抱住了柏木的小腿用脸颊摩挲，最后终于亲吻起来。

en.t: then immediately knelt on the stones of Shimura, held Kashiwagi's lower leg, rubbed it with her cheek, and finally began to kiss it.
